subject: Re: Dedicated capacity: GPU flavor & burst capacity request
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@aeroblend.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Dedicated capacity: GPU flavor & burst capacity request

Hi Sofia,

Quick one — our engineers validated a new model build over the weekend and the performance delta on p7-like instances is significant. We need to move our reserved pool from A100 to an H100-equivalent for an initial 8-week window and also want the ability to burst above reservation for short periods during the first 4 weeks of ramp.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood temporarily hold our reservation (60% of the committed capacity) while procurement completes PO approval? We expect PO in ~3 weeks but need capacity preserved.
- Can we get a capped burst policy (up to 2x reservation for bursts) and a preferred overage rate for the first billing cycle?

Attached is the updated SOW and a short perf report. We are sensitive to pricing but this is time-critical — if we can get a short-term concession on overage rates and the reservation hold, we can sign the amendment quickly.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Director of Infrastructure
Aeroblend

Attachment: aeroblend_capacity_sow.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

Forwarding Aeroblend's ask — they want: H100-equivalent for 8 weeks, burst up to 2x for 4 weeks, and a temporary reservation hold while procurement completes (PO ~3 weeks). They attached an SOW and asked for a preferred overage rate for the first billing cycle.

My read: high-value account (pilot to paid expansion), expected monthly consumption ~1.2M tokens and burst peaks 2-3x weekly for ~1 hour. The reservation hold is the blocker for procurement. I can negotiate contract language but need signoff on:
- GPU swap to H100-equivalent for a 8-week migration window
- Temporary reservation hold for 21 days (or until PO), no auto-release if PO delayed within that window
- Discounted overage rate for month 1 (proposed 20% off list overage)

This is time-sensitive — they say they can sign the amendment if we can confirm. Vivek, Marissa: need exec ok for >15% concession. Soojin: need confirmation on whether finance can accept a 21-day hold and the accounting treatment.

--
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the summary, Sofia.

A few things I need to understand before I can give a green light:
1) Delta to committed pricing for H100-equivalent during the 8-week window (per-month uplift).
2) Projected incremental spend from burst (estimate for month 1).
3) Legal / SOW impact — will this be an amendment to current reserved contract or a new temporary reservation?

If the ask is a simple SKU swap and a temporary hold, I'm open to approving a one-time concession up to 20% off overage for month 1, provided we have Marissa's sign-off on the discount and Soojin confirms accounting. Marissa — can you please sign off if you agree? If >20% is needed, escalate to exec table.

Vivek
VP Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 13:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Dedicated capacity: GPU flavor & burst capacity request

Numbers from finance perspective:
- If we swap reservation SKU to H100-equivalent, the committed monthly charge increases by ~$24,500 (estimate based on current sizing).
- Projected burst overage for month 1 (if they hit 2x peaks 3x/week for 1 hour): ~ $9,200.
- We can offer a 10% concession on overage as a standard finance-approved promotional concession. Anything above 15% requires Revenue Ops approval; >20% needs Head of RevOps (Marissa) + CFO visibility.

Reservation hold: finance can mark the reservation as 'on-hold' for up to 30 days with a PO expected note; the accounting treatment is to defer revenue recognition until PO or revised SOW is executed. That's fine operationally but requires procurement/finance on their side to acknowledge.

I recommend: approve H100 swap and reservation hold (30 days), offer 15% overage concession by default. If Sales wants 20% to secure an immediate signature, need Marissa's written approval.

-Soojin
Director, Revenue Finance
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Dedicated capacity: GPU flavor & burst capacity request

Sofia — thanks for flagging and for the context. I approve the following executive concessions for Aeroblend, conditional on a signed amendment within 21 days:
- Approve migration to H100-equivalent for an 8-week window starting on amended SOW effective date.
- Temporary reservation hold for 21 calendar days from amendment issuance (we will extend only if there's clear PO progress and legal sign-off).
- Overages: 20% off list rate for the first billing cycle after cutover (one-time concession).

Constraints/requirements:
- Sales to attach the amended SOW and the redline; procurement must return a signed PO within the 21-day hold or reservation will be released.
- Limit burst to 2x reservation and cap aggregate burst consumption at 150% of reserved monthly commit for billing purposes (finance to bill overage for consumption beyond that cap).
- Legal to approve a short amendment that explicitly states the hold and the burst cap.

Once we have their signature I will mark this as approved on the deal desk queue and instruct billing to apply the one-time concession.

Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@aeroblend.com>, procurement@aeroblend.com
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity: GPU flavor & burst capacity request

Elena — good news. Leadership has approved the request with the following binding terms: 

1) GPU migration: Redwood will swap the reserved pool to an H100-equivalent for an 8-week migration window starting on the effective date in the amendment.
2) Reservation hold: We will place a temporary hold on 60% of the committed reservation for 21 calendar days from amendment issuance to give procurement time to return the signed PO. If PO not returned within 21 days, reservation will be released unless both parties agree to extend in writing.
3) Burst policy: Aeroblend may burst up to 2x the reservation. Aggregate burst consumption beyond 150% of monthly reserved commit will be billed as overage.
4) Pricing concession: One-time 20% concession on list overage rates for the first billing cycle after cutover (applied by billing once we have a signed amendment).

Next steps: I have uploaded a redlined amendment and the amended SOW to the HubSpot deal (HS-43812) and created a DocuSign envelope for signature: https://docusign.com/link/ABC123. Please sign the amendment within 21 days so we can lock the reservation.

Attachments: aeroblend_capacity_sow.pdf, redwood_terms_redline.docx

Happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk through the amendment.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
